thread:
Sam (sales-eng): Quick prep for BeaconPay POC tomorrow. They want SSO-only invites, SCIM group sync, an ephemeral CI service account, and billing separated from inference ops. Also asked whether a short Dedicated trial is possible for a stress run.
Alex (infra): We can do SSO-only workspace and disable static API keys. SCIM -> role mapping supported. For CI use an ephemeral svc account that only has `svc-inference`.
Priya (security): Minimal RBAC: `svc-inference` (mint ephemeral tokens + call inference), `billing-view` (billing only), `viewer` (read-only). Only POC owner gets `workspace-admin`. Recommend IP allowlist for token minting and disable model uploads unless requested.
Mateo (acct exec): Pricing: for a 7-14 day Dedicated trial we can offer a prorated small reserved pool. If they have low sustained QPS hosted + credits might be cheaper. Need their avg token size and peak QPS.
Jordan (solutions): If they expect >100 rps sustained or large token sizes, Dedicated is better. Otherwise start hosted with strict SSO and move to Dedicated later.
Sam (sales-eng): Can you drop a minimal invite JSON I can give their infra team to automate?
Alex (infra): Minimal SCIM-friendly invite payload to POST to our onboarding endpoint:
```json
{
  "email": "ci-bot@beaconpay.com",
  "display_name": "BeaconPay POC CI",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "beacon-poc",
  "expires_at": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Sam (sales-eng): Nice. And example CLI to mint ephemeral token?
Alex (infra): CLI (1h TTL):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/beaconpay/ephemeral_tokens" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role":"svc-inference","ttl_seconds":3600}'
```
Priya (security): I'll prepare the questionnaire reply: require SAML metadata, `groups` claim mapping, encrypted assertions, disable static keys, optional IP allowlist for minting, and KMS recommendation for Private if they use sensitive data.
onboard-bot: Onboarding link: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/beaconpay (valid 6 days) :link:
Sam (sales-eng): Action items: Alex - post SCIM docs + invite example; Priya - draft security reply; Jordan - pricing delta for short Dedicated trial; Mateo - confirm billing-role email. I'll send the invite template to their infra lead now.
